📜 1. Definition, 3 Zones & Regulations | परिभाषा, 3 क्षेत्र व नियम - SSC Super Important

Fig: 3 Zones - Core No Human Strict Protection, Buffer Limited Research Education, Transition Settlement Farming Sustainable Use - 3 Functions Conservation Development Logistic Support - UNESCO MAB 1971

Biosphere Reserve Definition / बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व परिभाषा:
Definition: Large area conserving biodiversity, ecosystem, species, genetic diversity & traditional lifestyle of tribal/local communities, focus on conservation + sustainable development + logistic support (research, monitoring, education, training). Largest protected area category includes National Parks, Wildlife Sanctuaries, Conservation Reserves, Community Reserves. Declared by Central Govt under UNESCO MAB guidelines? Actually notified by Central Govt on recommendation State Govt & MoEFCC. Not under Wildlife Protection Act 1972 directly? Actually? But managed by MoEFCC. UNESCO MAB Programme launched 1971 Man and the Biosphere Programme Science for Sustainability Support Sites goal harmonize conservation of biodiversity with sustainable use by local communities. World Network of Biosphere Reserves 748 BR in 134 countries as of 2024.
परिभाषा: जैव विविधता पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र प्रजाति आनुवंशिक विविधता व जनजातीय स्थानीय समुदाय पारंपरिक जीवन शैली संरक्षण बड़ा क्षेत्र संरक्षण+सतत विकास+सहायता समर्थन (अनुसंधान निगरानी शिक्षा प्रशिक्षण) पर केंद्रित सबसे बड़ा संरक्षित क्षेत्र श्रेणी राष्ट्रीय उद्यान वन्यजीव अभयारण्य संरक्षण रिजर्व सामुदायिक रिजर्व शामिल, केंद्र सरकार घोषित यूनेस्को एमएबी दिशानिर्देश राज्य सरकार व पर्यावरण वन जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय सिफारिश पर, वन्यजीव संरक्षण अधिनियम 1972 के तहत सीधे नहीं पर MoEFCC प्रबंधित, यूनेस्को एमएबी कार्यक्रम 1971 मानव और जीवमंडल कार्यक्रम विज्ञान सततता समर्थन स्थल लक्ष्य जैव विविधता संरक्षण स्थानीय समुदाय सतत उपयोग सामंजस्य, विश्व बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व नेटवर्क 134 देशों में 748 बीआर 2024 तक
3 Interrelated Zones / 3 परस्पर संबंधित क्षेत्र - Image-wise Most Asked SSC:
1. CORE ZONE - No Human: Innermost strictly protected ecosystem no human habitation/activity, Scientific monitoring & natural processes only, Role: Conservation of landscapes, species & genetic diversity, Key features: No human habitation/activity, Strictly protected ecosystem & biodiversity, Scientific monitoring & natural processes only. Image: forest mountain deer birds no human. SSC: Core = NO HUMAN Activity = Strict Protection.
2. BUFFER ZONE - Limited Research & Education: Surrounds core, Activities compatible with conservation, Supports research, education, monitoring to protect core zone, Limited research & monitoring, Environmental education & experiments, Education & training activities, Eco-friendly tourism & recreation, Role: Surrounds core protects core. Image: microscope education hiking eco-tourism. SSC: Buffer = LIMITED Research & Education = Controlled Activities.
3. TRANSITION ZONE - Settlement, Farming & Sustainable Use: Outermost, Settlement farming & sustainable use, Human settlements & villages, Sustainable use of natural resources, Sustainable agriculture & farming, Local livelihoods: Eco-tourism, forestry, businesses, Role: Human settlements sustainable use communities live. Image: houses villages farming sustainable agriculture eco-tourism forestry businesses. SSC: Transition = SETTLEMENT & FARMING = Sustainable Use by Communities.
3 Functions: Function 1 Conservation - Protect genetic resources species ecosystem Maintain natural habitats biodiversity Preserve environment future generations. Function 2 Development - Promote sustainable livelihoods economy Support research education training Balance human needs conservation. Function 3 Logistic Support - Research monitoring environmental education Training programs local communities Cooperation knowledge sharing.
1. कोर क्षेत्र - मानव नहीं सबसे अंदरूनी कड़ाई से संरक्षित पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र मानव बसावट गतिविधि नहीं वैज्ञानिक निगरानी प्राकृतिक प्रक्रिया केवल भूमिका परिदृश्य प्रजाति आनुवंशिक विविधता संरक्षण, 2. बफर क्षेत्र - सीमित अनुसंधान शिक्षा कोर के चारों ओर संरक्षण संगत गतिविधियां अनुसंधान शिक्षा निगरानी कोर संरक्षण समर्थन सीमित अनुसंधान निगरानी पर्यावरण शिक्षा प्रयोग शिक्षा प्रशिक्षण ईको फ्रेंडली पर्यटन मनोरंजन भूमिका कोर के चारों ओर कोर सुरक्षा, 3. ट्रांजिशन क्षेत्र - बसावट खेती सतत उपयोग सबसे बाहरी बसावट खेती सतत उपयोग मानव बसावट गांव प्राकृतिक संसाधन सतत उपयोग सतत कृषि खेती स्थानीय आजीविका ईको पर्यटन वानिकी व्यवसाय भूमिका मानव बसावट सतत उपयोग समुदाय रहना
Regulations & Difference NP vs WLS vs BR | नियम व अंतर:
NP: No human habitation, No grazing forestry cultivation, Highest protection, Boundaries fixed legislation, Cannot be denotified without NBWL, Area small strict. WLS: Some activities allowed with permission limited grazing forest produce collection, Settlement may exist limited, Can be upgraded to NP. BR: Zoned Core Buffer Transition, UNESCO MAB, Sustainable development, Largest area includes NP WLS, Human settlements allowed in Transition sustainable use, 3 functions Conservation Development Logistic Support, Not under Wildlife Protection Act 1972 directly but MoEFCC guidelines, Focus biodiversity ecosystem traditional lifestyle. SSC: BR = Zoned + UNESCO MAB + Sustainable development + Largest area + Includes NP WLS.

🌍 3. UNESCO MAB - 12 UNESCO Biosphere Reserves (13 incl Cold Desert 2025) | यूनेस्को एमएबी

UNESCO Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Programme 1971 / यूनेस्को मानव और जीवमंडल कार्यक्रम 1971:
Launched 1971 UNESCO, Science for Sustainability Support Sites, Goal harmonize conservation of biodiversity with sustainable use by local communities, World Network of Biosphere Reserves 748 BR in 134 countries as of 2024, India 12 UNESCO MAB as of 2024 (13 incl Cold Desert 2025). Criteria: Biodiversity, ecosystem protection, sustainable development, logistic support research education training cooperation. UNESCO MAB logo = UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves.
